measurements.name: Pacific North Equatorial Undercurrent
measurements.range_interpretation: Southern and northern component breadths differ in the same climatological mean. They are not a single-current width range or annual minimum/maximum.
measurements.geographic_scope: Pacific NEUC southern/northern quasi-stationary jet components in the Argo mean; no fixed width section longitude or paired endpoints supplied.
measurements.section_orientation: Meridional latitude breadth; flow-normal span unresolved for tilting jets.
measurements.layer: 27.0 sigma-theta potential-density-anomaly surface (kg/m3), with spatially varying depth; no fixed numeric depth layer.
measurements.time_convention: Argo 2004-2014 climatological mean, year precision only. Not LICOM/SODA 1969-2007, exact observation dates or a seasonal calendar.
measurements.boundary_rule: Approximate component breadth reported in Mean Structures of NEUCs prose. Width edge criterion and endpoints are not supplied. Figure 1 zero contours are not digitized width boundaries.
measurements.source_citation: Li, Y., Liu, H. and Lin, P. (2018), Interannual and decadal variability of the North Equatorial Undercurrents in an eddy-resolving ocean model, Scientific Reports 8, 17112, doi:10.1038/s41598-018-35469-2.
measurements.source_locator: Complete JATS Results / Mean Structures of NEUCs, first paragraph, Figure 1(a) and caption; Methods / Observation and assimilation datasets.
measurements.extraction_method: Numerical prose transcribed from complete archived JATS; source Figures 1 and 2 visually reviewed. WGS84 latitude-span unit conversion, rounded to 10 km; no plot-edge digitization.
measurements.source_quality_note: Approximate meridional breadth of a long-term geostrophic mean; no numeric width uncertainty, fixed section or monthly widths. Spatially varying density-surface depth is distinct from a fixed depth.
remaining_gates: Acquire and reprocess the stated original Argo climatology and velocity diagnostic.
Recover section-specific density-surface width edges and errors before physical footprints or state joins.
Matched repeated measurements before annual width margins or seasonal playback.

scope_notes: Approximate 3 and 1 degree widths belong to distinct southern and northern jets; not a width range for one jet.
27.0 sigma-theta is a potential-density-anomaly surface, not a fixed metre depth or vertically integrated layer.
Argo mean 2004-2014 is distinct from the SODA and LICOM 1969-2007 fields displayed in other source panels.
Source cores near 8, 13 and 18 N around 130-135 E are context, not measured width-section locations or constant jet axes.
No widths assigned to the generic cross-basin NEUC, surface NEC or Tsuchiya subsurface countercurrents.
No exact middle-jet breadth, width edge threshold, width error, annual margins or monthly width playback supported here.
